main.description: Notify that a permissioned repo in a space has advanced to a new revision. Sent by a repo host to the space host, and forwarded by the space host to registered syncers with the space's sequence (spaceRev, prevSpaceRev). Carries no record data; delivery is best-effort. Authenticated with service auth. rsky also accepts the earlier names rev (for repoRev, before the 2026-10-01 spaces alpha) and hash (for data, before the 2026-10-22 one).

space.description: Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.

repo.description: The DID of the repo's author.

repoRev.description: The repo's new commit revision. An update with a lower or equal revision is ignored.

data.description: The repo's commit data after the write: sha256 of the LtHash state. Unauthenticated; a reason for a syncer to fetch the head commit, never proof of it.

spaceRev.description: The space revision the space host assigned this update. On forwards to syncers only.

prevSpaceRev.description: The space revision before spaceRev; absent on a space's first update. On forwards to syncers only.
